snippet.title: Zeroth - Teaser Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
Zeroth is a roguelike platformer with physics simulation and deep mechanics. Learn the rules of the world through hilarious deaths and guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

Coming to Steam. Follow us at https://linktr.ee/contrarygames.

#indiedev #gamedev #platformer #nethack
